test_title: PYST 29: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six people A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). E is sitting second to the left of C. C is an immediate neighbour of both A and B. F is sitting third to the right of A. How many people are sitting between D and C when counted from the left of D?
solution:
Given:

Six people A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

1) E is sitting second to the left of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6e53667937a379201439e82fb48890d6c911e798a5b0e3e94e11d383e296056.png] 

2) C is an immediate neighbour of both A and B.

3) F is sitting third to the right of A. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1290439cb1cb3662e8cc87437c8009cdaa54c1e9697c7c472309c44266357dc.png] 

So, '2' people are sitting between D and C when counted from the left of D.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (3)".**
